data.title: Rove City Walk
data.about:
Welcome to Rove at City Walk. A modern hotel brand with a return on investment of up to 8% on hotel rooms. 

Hotel investment in Dubai is a lucrative way to earn significant returns due to the high influx of tourists.

characteristics_module.title: Rove City Walk Return on Investment

• Starting at AED 773K

location_tile.title: Located at the epicenter
location_tile.description:
Rove City Walk is located at the epicenter of Dubai in City Walk. It is close to Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa. It is the perfect location for tourists and business travelers who are traveling to Dubai.

  • 05 mins – Burj Khalifa
  • 05 mins – The Dubai Mall & Downtown Dubai
  • 10 mins – Dubai Fountain
  • 10 mins – Dubai Opera
  • 10 mins – La Mer in Jumeirah
  • 15 mins – Dubai International Airport
